text: If a memory feels too big to redo on your own, there's an actual clinical therapy for that, called Imagery Rescripting, which I only found out about after I wrote this section. The therapist has you picture them stepping into the memory as the adult you needed, until you learn to be that adult yourself.
reader: an adult reading the inner child guide's way of redoing a painful memory with a corrected version, deciding whether to do it alone or with help
